about_the_game:
ITS SLIME TIME! With a large kit of slime abilities, venture into the I-Valley to save your family and choose from multiple Primary & Secondary abilities to take on the enemies that stand in your way.

OLD RELICS, NEW TRICKS! Throughout your adventure, you will acquire items called relics which will power Puddles up and make your abilities act in interesting new ways once equipped. Want your slime trail to get super long and deal tons of damage? Or maybe you want that shiny new ability you unlocked to be a knockback machine!

REBUILD, REGROW, RE-SLIME! After a raid on the slime village, all the slimes have gone into hiding in the I-Valley or been kidnapped - OH NO! On your way to save your family, send the slimes you find back to the slime village where they will be safe and sound once again.

short_description: Slime Guy is a 2D rogue-lite dungeon-crawler where you enter as Puddles. A seemingly weak slime whose family has been kidnapped and taken into the I-Valley. Do you have what it takes to save your family?
